title: Require explicit approval for local document reads (#1325)
body: Refs #1325. Owner-approved repair for the document path findings blocking #1371. Chat attachments and document extraction/ingestion APIs now use Mana's existing approval queue, forced human review, one-use grants scoped to path/session/purpose, a bounded queue and expiring metadata-only grants. Opened files are checked against the approved identity before and after a bounded read; handles close on success or failure. HTTP paths no longer flow directly into document extraction. Adds real authenticated API, changed-file cleanup, expiry, scope, denial, queue and plugin regressions. Full CI and security checks are required before merge; no alerts are dismissed.
interface: The merged change for PR #1378 is covered by test/document-access.test.js, test/reply-stream-route.test.js.
why: Additional real merged-fix benchmark case selected to broaden the agentic coding evaluation.
